Package network.ike.foundation.ike.model

package network.ike.foundation.ike.model
  • Class
    Description
    ModelBridges
    The bridges and readings authored beside the model files: what a retrievable class stands for in IKE's own terms, and which statement reading each of its elements answers.
    ModelBridges.Bridge
    What a retrievable class stands for.
    ModelBridges.Reading
    Which statement reading an element answers.
    ModelIdentity
    Where every imported model component gets its identity (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1115): derived, never random.
    ModelImporter
    Reads a model information file into the store as knowledge (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1115): a concept for the model under the Data model parent, a concept for each class under its base class, its name and label read in the model's dialect, its definition as the file writes it, a class that extends a System type or has no base under the model's concept, since nothing hangs under the catalog's types, a record for the model and for each class with every field verbatim and IKE's resolution beside it, a record for each element with its type as a tree of the catalog's type specifiers, and records for the contexts, the relationships, the conversions, and the required models.
    ModelImporter.Report
    What an import did.
    ModelImportException
    A model information file that cannot be imported, refused with its place: which file, which class or element, and what was missing or could not be resolved.
    ModelInfoFile
    A model information file as the CQL translator writes it, read as it is: the model's own facts, the models it requires, its classes with their elements, its contexts, and its conversions, every attribute verbatim.
    ModelInfoFile.ClassInfo
    One class as the file writes it.
    ModelInfoFile.Context
    A context a library may run in.
    ModelInfoFile.Conversion
    A conversion between two types.
    ModelInfoFile.Element
    One element of a class, every attribute as written.
    ModelInfoFile.Form
    The forms a type specifier takes in a shipped file.
    ModelInfoFile.Relationship
    How a class reaches a context.
    ModelInfoFile.Requirement
    A model this model requires.
    ModelInfoFile.TypeSpecifier
    A type as the file gives it, in one of its four forms.
    ModelInfoGenerator
    Writes a family of IKE's own patterns as model information (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1115), so that a library can be written against IKE's own knowledge.
    ModelTypes
    The data models as the store holds them after import: each model with its name, version, and url, each class with its model and its base, so that a type name met in a library resolves to the class concept and a class concept writes back as the name a library uses.
    ModelTypes.ClassEntry
    A class in the store.
    ModelTypes.Model
    A model in the store.
